description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the 'Blog' extension module in the OpenCart admin control panel. It extends the base Controller class and includes methods for displaying the module's interface ('index') and handling save operations ('save'). The class manages loading language strings, retrieving module configuration, and setting up data for rendering the module editing page.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Blog module in the OpenCart admin area. It handles displaying the module configuration page and saving module settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the blog module configuration page. Loads language data, sets up breadcrumbs, retrieves existing module data if editing, and renders the view with the collected data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module configuration. Checks permissions, validates input, adds or updates the module in the database, and returns a JSON response indicating success or errors.
